title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Supply and Demand
description: This lesson quiz checks what you learned in the lesson. Submitting it meets the lesson's completion requirement (quiz submitted), and your score is recorded separately.

history.note: AI-written question draft. Not yet reviewed by a teacher; do not give to students.

v2: Revised based on review comments (docs/content/c02-review.md): balanced answer positions, replaced weak distractors, replaced questions that could be copied from worked examples. Not yet reviewed by a human.
Rewritten in English from the Korean draft. Not reviewed or approved by a human.

questions.prompt: Hypothetical example: "When a carton of milk in the school cafeteria costs 50 cents, students want to buy 200 cartons a day." What does the 200 cartons describe?
Other things being equal, the price of face masks rises. What happens on the supply side of the face mask market?

choices.text: Quantity supplied falls along the curve
The supply curve itself shifts right
Quantity supplied rises along the curve

questions.prompt: Incomes rise, and people now want to buy more sneakers (a normal good) even at the same price. What happens in the sneaker market?

choices.text: There is a movement down along the demand curve
The demand curve itself shifts to the right
The supply curve shifts to the right
The demand curve shifts to the left

questions.prompt: Which of the following shifts a good's supply curve to the left?

choices.text: Raw material and labor costs rise

questions.prompt: The demand function for a good was Qd = 90 − 3P. Then incomes rose, and quantity demanded increased by 15 at every price. What is the new quantity demanded at P = 12? (Enter a number only.)
